periods.label: 寻找裸体模特儿的染血达文西

name.jp: サラ・ブラッドリリー

status.current: attends the banquet and becomes fixated on using Ikki as a nude model

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Declares his face and body ideal for her art and tries to drag him away as a nude model.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Kicked unconscious by Shizuku after tearing Ikki's shirt.
relationships.rinna-kazamatsuri: Akatsuki teammate who explains that Sara is an artist, not a warrior.

periods.summary: Sara appears openly at the Seven Stars banquet despite Akatsuki's recent attack on Hagun. She ignores politics and focuses on Ikki's body as her ideal subject, tearing his shirt and trying to force him to pose nude. Shizuku knocks her out. Rinna warns Ikki not to underestimate Sara because her art can supplant reality even if Sara herself is physically fragile and accident-prone.

key_events.summary: Harasses Ikki as a model and is removed after Shizuku kicks her.
